answer.reason: Topheth has a few defining events: its high places were built for burning children, King Josiah defiled it, and the LORD pronounced it would be renamed the valley of slaughter.

clauses.english: had high places built on it where sons and daughters were burned in the fire
clauses.quote: they have built the high places of Tophet

clauses.english: was defiled by the king so that no one could make his son or daughter pass through the fire to Molech
was declared by the LORD to be renamed the valley of slaughter, where they would bury till there was no place
clauses.quote: this place shall no more be called Tophet

doubts: ISA 30:33 uses Tophet as a figure of fiery judgment on the Assyrian and the king, so it was left out as not an event of the place.
JER 19:14 only says Jeremiah came from Tophet, so it was not used.
